    "Model forecasts are consistently too low by 0.1-0.3 for the first 5-10 days, showing significant lag behind price momentum",

    "Mean reversion bias: model maintains prices too close to recent range (within 0.5 of last 18 days), missing genuine trend extensions",
    "When sentiment has been strongly positive (1.00) for 3+ consecutive entries, model underpredicts by 0.25-0.45",
    "Price volatility is systematically understated - 20-30% smaller swings than actual across all 30-day horizons",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast error: 1.00 sentiment adds 0.15-0.30 bias, 0.00 sentiment subtracts 0.05-0.10"
